findings.evidenceJa: 小木曽が北原の馬鹿に騙されて
findings.explanation: Kazusa says Setsuna was fooled by the idiot Kitahara and carelessly joined the club. The English makes Haruki's abstract stupidity the agent that deceived her, producing a nonsensical relation and removing Kazusa's direct insult.
findings.japanese:
「小木曽が北原の馬鹿に騙されて、
のこのこ同好会に入るから悪いんだぞ」
findings.todokanai: "It's all your fault for being deceived by Kitahara's stupidity and carelessly joining the club, Ogiso."

findings.highlight: so passionate about your own values
findings.evidenceJa: 二人揃って、思い込みの激しさはそっくりだな
findings.explanation: Kazusa says Haruki and Setsuna are alike in how intensely they jump to conclusions or commit to assumptions. The English recasts this shared cognitive flaw as passion about personal values, changing her diagnosis of why they suit each other.
findings.japanese:
「二人揃って、思い込みの激しさはそっくりだな。
…ある意味、お似合いかも」
findings.todokanai: "The two of you are really so passionate about your own values, huh. …In a way, I guess the two of you might really be a good match…"

findings.highlight: a hypocrite who only cares about his own image
findings.explanation: Kazusa calls Haruki a self-denying hypocrite who stubbornly endures and puts on a brave face. The English invents concern for his public image, replacing the compulsive self-restraint that defines his behavior with vanity.
findings.japanese:
「しつこくて、ウザくて、価値観の押しつけばかりで、
強引で、独りよがりで、やせ我慢の偽善者なところとか」
findings.todokanai: "He's persistent, annoying, forces his own values on others, brazen, self-righteous, and a hypocrite who only cares about his own image…"

findings.highlight: You won't be able to have him for yourself
findings.evidenceJa: 冬馬さんのものじゃ、なくしちゃったんだよ
findings.explanation: Setsuna says she took Haruki and made him no longer Kazusa's, explicitly framing her act as theft from a prior claim. The English changes this to Kazusa's future inability to have him, weakening Setsuna's confession of guilt and the presupposed emotional ownership.
findings.japanese:
「わたし…春希くん取っちゃったんだよ？
冬馬さんのものじゃ、なくしちゃったんだよ？」
findings.todokanai: "I've taken Haruki-kun away, you know? You won't be able to have him for yourself, Touma-san, you know?"

findings.highlight: "Then, I'll tell you one last thing as a friend… Kitahara's not a good match for you at all, Ogiso."
findings.evidenceJa:
「じゃあ、もう一度友人として言ってやる。
…小木曽に北原なんて似合わない」
findings.explanation: Setsuna asks whether they can become friends once again; the English says one last time.
findings.japanese:
「じゃあ、もう一度友人として言ってやる。
…小木曽に北原なんて似合わない」
findings.todokanai: "Then, I'll tell you one last thing as a friend… Kitahara's not a good match for you at all, Ogiso."

findings.highlight: "I've accepted both of my friends' promises. Anything more would be a pain, so I'll give you my blessing as well."
findings.evidenceJa:
「あたしは、あたしの友達二人の約束を認める。
それと、あとがめんどくさいから祝福してやる」
findings.explanation: One shared commitment or promise involving her two friends is pluralized into both friends' separate promises.
findings.japanese:
「あたしは、あたしの友達二人の約束を認める。
それと、あとがめんどくさいから祝福してやる」
findings.todokanai: "I've accepted both of my friends' promises. Anything more would be a pain, so I'll give you my blessing as well."

findings.highlight: Having to worry about the likes of Kitahara is just irritating too
findings.evidenceJa: 北原ごときに心配されるのもむかつく
findings.explanation: Kazusa is irritated at being worried about by someone like Haruki. The English reverses the concern and says Kazusa has to worry about Haruki, changing who is vulnerable and who is caring.
findings.japanese:
「だから、この話はおしまいだ。
…北原ごときに心配されるのもむかつく。
今まで通り…全部、今まで通りにしてやるよ」
findings.todokanai: "That's why this conversation is finished. Having to worry about the likes of Kitahara is just irritating too. Let's just carry on with everything… carry on like we've always done up until now."
